categories.main_business_segments: ARE Holdings operates two main business segments: the Precious Metals Business and the Environmental Preservation Business. The Precious Metals segment focuses on recycling and refining precious and rare metals such as gold, silver, palladium, platinum, and rhodium from scrap materials, while the Environmental Preservation segment is engaged in the collection, transportation, and intermediate treatment of industrial waste.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced dry and wet refining technologies for precious metals, integrating automation and robotics to enhance efficiency and reduce costs. It also develops chemical and physical stripping techniques for precious metals recovery, high-precision analytical methods (such as X-ray and ICP analysis), and innovative waste treatment and resource recovery technologies, including waste-to-energy and hydrogen production from waste.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include trading companies, jewelry manufacturers, semiconductor and electronic component manufacturers, and companies in the dental and automotive catalyst sectors. The end markets are primarily electronics, automotive, jewelry, and industrial manufacturing, with a strong focus on B2B relationships.
categories.geographic_coverage: ARE Holdings has a global footprint with major operations in Japan, North America (USA and Canada), and Asia (Malaysia, Singapore, South Korea, Thailand, and India). Sales are also significant in Europe, particularly Switzerland and the UK, reflecting a broad international customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates both upstream and midstream in the supply chain. It sources scrap and raw materials, processes and refines them into high-purity precious metals, and supplies these materials to manufacturers and trading companies, as well as providing intermediate waste treatment services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding precious metals recycling, developing new industrial applications (such as pharmaceuticals and hydrogen production), advancing global operations, and promoting sustainability through decarbonization and responsible sourcing. R&D focuses on refining process innovation, automation, environmental impact reduction, and new recycling technologies, with active collaboration with universities and external research institutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of refined precious metals and related products, as well as service fees for industrial waste collection, treatment, and resource recovery. The company also earns income from value-added services such as precious metal stripping, precision cleaning, and storage (depository) services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ARE Holdings is a leading player in the Japanese and global precious metals recycling and refining industry, competing with other major refiners and recyclers. Its strong market position is supported by advanced technology, global operations, and a reputation for responsible sourcing and environmental management.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, consolidated revenue reached 506.2 billion yen, up 57.1% year-on-year, with operating profit of 20.0 billion yen. The company has demonstrated robust growth, particularly in the precious metals segment, and maintains a significant asset base (490.0 billion yen). However, net profit declined due to extraordinary factors, and the equity ratio decreased to 25.8%, reflecting increased leverage for business expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ARE Holdings differentiates itself through its integrated recycling and refining capabilities, high-purity products, and commitment to sustainability and responsible sourcing (including conflict-free and environmentally friendly metals). The company emphasizes technological leadership, global reach, and the ability to provide high-value-added solutions that support the circular economy and decarbonization efforts for its customers.
